max_lines.description: The most lines one `read` answer carries; a longer range answers with `more: {from, to}`.

max_chars.description: The most characters of formatted lines one `read` answer carries; beyond it `more` names the next range.

search_limit.description: The most hits one `search` answer lists (`total` counts all of them).

diff_lines.description: The most lines of one `diff`; a longer diff is cut and says `truncated`.

description.purpose: Every read of the space except `ask` and the semantic search: `info`, `read`, `search` (exact, regex), `summary`, `history`, `show`, `diff`, `list`, `find`, `raw`. It resolves an address (id or path; head, `@<hex>`, `@ws:`, `@snap:`, a prepared commit read all-or-nothing), puts a version together from its blocks and answers with the version token. It never writes a file; its one written table is `pending`.
description.use_when: Inside a file space only, behind `in_read`.
description.not_in_scope: No write, no recovery of a prepared commit (`./ws` does that), no semantic search (`./derive`).
description.emits_meaning: `read_store` to `./store` between phases, `answer` once per request.
description.consumes_meaning: A request on `in_read`, and the store's answers to its own reads.
